name: Dragonfly Shops & Gardens
tagline: Succulent gardens, handcrafted gifts & artisan workshops in a 1920s cottage
description: Tucked into a sunlit 1920s cottage and garden oasis on North Glassell Street, Dragonfly Shops & Gardens is a treasure trove of succulents, garden pottery, handcrafted jewelry, mosaic art, and fair-trade home decor. Visitors stroll through peaceful outdoor garden paths and participate in hands-on workshops in fairy gardening, succulent wreath making, resin crafts, and glass mosaics.
historicNote: Housed in an authentic historic 1920s residential bungalow with lush outdoor garden courtyards, preserving Old Towne's residential-commercial craft heritage.

specials.title: Wednesday Succulent Bar & Planting Special
specials.description: Pick your pot and succulents from the outdoor potting table with complimentary soil and decorative pebbles.

specials.title: Handmade Artisan Jewelry & Gift Showcase
specials.description: Featured local Southern California jewelry artisans, hand-poured candles, and artisan stationery.

specials.title: Cottage Garden Stroll & Porch Decor
specials.description: Browse wind chimes, vintage garden stakes, bird baths, and patio accents in the shaded garden walkway.

specials.title: Saturday Morning Garden & Craft Workshop
specials.description: Hands-on succulent arrangement and fairy garden classes on the garden patio starting at 10 AM.

specials.title: Sunday Afternoon Plant Therapy Stroll
specials.description: Leisurely afternoon plant shopping, miniature fairy accessories, and rare drought-tolerant specimens.

events.title: Fairy Garden & Succulent Arrangement Workshop
events.description: Create your own living succulent dish garden or miniature fairy wonderland under the garden arbor.
